_note: Fully synthetic English re-identification-risk eval fixture. No real people. Separate single-language pool (NOT merged with the zh fixture): mixing scripts lets an LLM re-identify trivially by language, inflating the metric. 18 personas, fully NON-CONFOUNDED: EVERY quasi-identifier field individually OVERLAPS across >=2 personas — 6 cities x3 (Chicago, Austin, Seattle, London, Manchester, Bristol), and each occupation, medical condition, hobby and exact age is shared by exactly 2 personas — so NO single field re-identifies anyone. Only the FULL combination (city x occupation x condition x hobby x age) is unique per persona, so identity is recoverable solely by COMBINING >=2 residuals. This deliberately removes two confounds at once: the original unique-city giveaway AND the follow-on unique-occupation giveaway. Each candidate summary lists ONLY quasi-identifiers (age + city/area + occupation + employer-type + a condition + a hobby) and NO explicit PII. Each profile is prose weaving explicit PII (US/UK name + phone + email) plus the SAME quasi-identifiers, so after explicit-PII removal only the partially-discriminating residuals (occupation/condition/hobby/age, with city clustered) remain — exactly the survivors the en detectors target.
